An '''adamant axe''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], made by smithing a [[diamond axe]] with [[adamant alloy]]. It has both the adamant tool intrinsics and the weapon's Weakness effect.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It breaks axe blocks at speed 15 and has 5000 durability. Logs it cuts drop charcoal. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|10}} damage at an attack speed of 1, tying the [[steel axe]] for damage with a faster swing. The adamant weapon intrinsic inflicts Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit. Weakened mobs are what the [[Doom]] intrinsic of adamant armor detonates.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Efficiency II, Unbreaking II, smelting and Weakness. The smelting intrinsic makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: ores drop ingots or [[silver bullion]], logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops stone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_axe.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. [[Divinity]] was replaced with Efficiency.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Now smelts the blocks it mines. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Now inflicts Weakness.}}
}}
